_about: Rows whose stored range_mi is knowingly not an EPA figure. The watch script lists them as accepted instead of flagging them. Remove an entry once EPA rates the trim.

range_mi.Lucid Gravity, 2027, GT-S: Lucid projection; EPA has not rated the GT-S.
range_mi.Lexus TZ, 2027, Premium Touring AWD: Lexus estimate; EPA has rated only the Premium so far.
range_mi.Lexus TZ, 2027, Luxury AWD: Lexus estimate; EPA has rated only the Premium so far.
range_mi.Tesla Model X, 2021, Plaid (5-seat): Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
range_mi.Tesla Model X, 2021, Plaid (6-seat): Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
range_mi.Tesla Model X, 2021, Plaid (7-seat): Tesla's figure for the refreshed 2021 Plaid; EPA's 2021 file has no Plaid entry.
